answer: Force every identity into an oasis cohort of eight strangers sharing one joint bond: each posts 40 tokens, so the cohort holds 320, and it earns only while all eight stay clean. If one member is proven fake, the whole bond burns and all eight freeze for six epochs. One honest agent risks one share in a vetted group, but a farmer with 100 fakes must either cluster them, where one detection wipes eight at once, or scatter them among honest members who can veto and report. Each fake thus risks eight bonds, and the delta from honest scale is ferrous-solid collateral one slip destroys.
